name: galactic-battle
description: Turns Claude Code's spinner into an animated space battle driven by what Claude does (tool results, helpers), with a double-bladed lightsaber gauge for context and quota, blaster sounds and optional music.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the battle's texts and of /battle's answers. auto follows LANG.

musicFile.title: Music file
musicFile.description: Absolute path (or ~/...) of the music played during a turn once /battle music on. Empty: ~/.claude/galactic-battle/music.mp3

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Volume of the blaster and the music, 0 to 100.

details.title: Info shown
details.description: tool: the battle shows tool names only. full: it also shows file names and commands (hide it when you record your screen).
